headline: The 5 parts of a reflex arc, in order
stat_note: receptor > sensory neuron > integration center > motor neuron > effector
body:
Knee-jerk (patellar) reflex: a monosynaptic arc with one synapse and no interneurons. The quadriceps is the effector.
Somatic reflexes end in skeletal muscle; autonomic reflexes end in smooth muscle, cardiac muscle or glands.
source: Source: Kenhub, The reflex arc; Lumen Learning, A&P I · Educational content

headline: Lung volumes and capacities explained
stat_note: tidal volume: the air moved in one quiet breath
body:
Vital capacity = IRV + tidal + ERV (all but residual volume).
Total lung capacity = vital capacity + residual volume, about 6,000 mL in men and 4,200 mL in women.
source: Source: Basic Human Physiology, IU Pressbooks · Educational content
